title: Preserve Queue table scroll on row selection
summary: Preserve the Queue table scroll position when selecting a row causes the queue rows to re-render.
reason: Selecting a row near the bottom of a long Queue table should keep the operator's table position instead of snapping the scrollable queue list back to the top.
behavior_before: Queue row selection updated selected-row state and detail panels, then re-rendered the queue table body; on long queues this could reset the scrollable table wrapper to the top while the lower row remained selected.
behavior_after: Queue row rendering snapshots the scrollable table wrapper offsets before replacing rows and restores/clamps them after the selected-row/detail refresh, keeping long-queue selection in place.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke.py asserts Queue table scroll is preserved after selecting a lower rendered row.
rollback_plan: Revert the Queue render scroll snapshot/restore helper, remove the focused large-table browser-smoke assertion, and remove this change packet.
notes: WebView-only queue table interaction fix. It does not change Local API routes, backend command authority, queue mutation, launch scope, settings persistence, media policy, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio behavior, pending publish drain, source/scratch/output movement, cleanup behavior, or source media files. Affected Python scripts: tests/python/desktop/test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke.py only.
